result.summary: The page layout is largely sound, but there is a broken promotional badge on the pizza card and some inconsistent styling in the 'Popular right now' list. Found 3 issues.

issues.description: The second card in 'Popular right now' shows a discount badge reading '-0%', which advertises a zero-value discount. This is almost certainly an unformatted/fallback value rather than a real promotion.
issues.suggestion: Hide the discount badge entirely when the discount value is 0 or null, and only render it for discounts greater than 0.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) buttons on the two 'Popular right now' cards use different styles: the first has a white circular background with a dark outline heart, while the second has a dark/transparent circular background with a white outline heart.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite button treatment across all cards (same background fill, size, and icon color), or apply a consistent scrim so it reads legibly over any image.

issues.description: The 'Green Bowl Poké' thumbnail in 'Fastest near you' appears washed out and very low contrast compared to the neighboring dark, richly-colored thumbnails, making the row look visually inconsistent.
issues.suggestion: Apply consistent image treatment (e.g., a subtle gradient overlay or matched background) so all carousel thumbnails have similar contrast, and ensure the time badge remains legible on light imagery.
